description: What Priors (priors.trade, USDG credit for ERC-8004 agents on Robinhood Chain) shows for an agent: credit line, loans repaid, active loans, default flag, score and what the next rung needs. Pass a 0x wallet (owner or declared wallet) or an ERC-8004 agent id. A labelled read of another service: it informs only, nothing is lent or signed here. Borrowing is approved by the agent's owner on Priors itself. Read only, free.
name: priors_standing
